title: The Bread End You Love Saved
youtube_title: The Bread End You Love Saved | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Remembering a kindness is a way of returning it.
summary: At a harbor shelter on the lee side of the wind, Kira notices that Neighbor Sami has already taken care of a bread end saved because you love the crust. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Kira does one useful thing Neighbor Sami did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
